projects.title: Retail Inventory & Sales Optimization Analytics
projects.description: A complex data pipeline to aggregate transactional records and identify sales trends.
projects.longDescription: This project features a PostgreSQL data pipeline to manage and analyze sales data. It utilizes ABC Analysis and EOQ models built in Python (Pandas) to optimize stock levels and prevent overstocking. Additionally, time-series demand forecasting models predict inventory requirements to avoid stockouts.
features: PostgreSQL data pipelines for sales trend analytics
ABC Analysis and EOQ models to optimize stock

projects.title: AI Interview Coach (MockMind AI)
projects.description: Multimodal platform using Computer Vision and NLP to analyze interview metrics.
projects.longDescription: Engineered a comprehensive multimodal software that analyzes human interviews through Computer Vision and NLP. It also leverages a reasoning engine backed by LangGraph, LangChain, and Qdrant Vector DB to deliver highly contextual insights for users to improve their interviewing skills.
features: Contextual insights via Qdrant Vector DB

projects.title: Deductly (Tax Analytics RAG)
projects.description: RAG-powered financial tool for tax-saving suggestions via semantic search.
projects.longDescription: Developed an advanced retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) tool using TypeScript and Python. It indexes massive financial datasets to provide users with accurate, context-aware suggestions for tax savings by performing efficient semantic search over indexed tax documents.
